name: Royal Commission into Aged Care Quality and Safety
why: Its final report is in the register: eight volumes presented by a Member on 27 July 2022, typed Other, volume 1 titled Summary and recommendations — the same shape as the Disability report. No government response to it is. What is there instead are two progress reports on implementation, which are a government's account of what it later did rather than what it said about each recommendation.
